author: Arnav
problem: hosts lists the host name of the referring site for each visit to a blog, such as 'www.example.com'. Return how many visits came from each site, ignoring capitalization and a leading 'www.'.
bug_description: Uses lstrip('www.'), which strips any leading 'w' and '.' characters rather than the 'www.' prefix, so 'www.wired.com' becomes 'ired.com'.

comments.accurate: Counts visits per site, ignoring case and a leading www.
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts visits per site, trimming leading w's and dots so www., ww. and w. prefixes all match
comments.wrong_location: Prefix handling verified; check each site's count starts from the right value
